Someone close to me wants a senior developer or a small team to build a real multilingual AI agent—not a chatbot or a UI-only mockup.
The goal: ONE secure AI brain linked across a Windows PC, an Android phone, and an optional cloud/VPS.
Voice/text control of apps, browsers, Office, files, settings, reports and multi-step tasks. Screen understanding, mouse/keyboard/UI automation, actions only with permission.
Real-time voice dialogue you can interrupt, in Hindi, Urdu, Hinglish, English & French; male/female voices, wake word, memory, basic offline mode and professional/friendly styles.
Dark dashboard with a blue 3D particle globe that reacts to the voice, a spoken greeting, music and animations.

Forex, XAUUSD/Gold, BTCUSD and other assets: live prices, news/economic calendar, charts, technical + Smart Money Concepts analysis, multi-timeframe setups, entry/SL/TP reasoning, risk management, alerts, journal, P&L and spoken briefings. Secure MT5 + existing in-house desktop trading tool integration without touching its current strategies. Optional, explicitly switched-on demo/live order execution with hard risk caps, confirmations, logging and an emergency stop—no promise of profit.

Owner-only approval for deletion, payments, pairing and live trades; on-device/biometric confirmation, encryption, activity logs and instant revoke/STOP. Modular agent orchestration, swappable cloud/local models (e.g., Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, Ollama), dependable low-latency STT/TTS, and clear running costs.
Working Windows .exe installer + Android APK, full buildable source, documentation, testing on real devices, security checks and a demo of every agreed feature. Not a cosmetic prototype.

LLM agents/tool use, Windows automation, Android/Kotlin/Accessibility, speech AI, secure cross-device architecture, 3D/WebGL UI, Python/TypeScript/.NET, and MT5/fintech APIs. A senior technical lead or a capable team is welcome.

Over the last few weeks I've been posting about what I build and how I approach it. Thanks to everyone who followed, commented and shared. Here is everything in one place.
• PuttPark: built and maintained the guest app for a chain of golf entertainment venues across the US. Guests send drinks to their bay, order food at the table, and keep track of their scores.
• Tillwise POS: led an iPad POS from zero to App Store release, with three card-terminal integrations and receipt printing. The venue group later acquired it as part of its POS setup.
• Brickhaus (Dubai): 8 years on a 3-app PropTech platform for tenants, maintenance crews and inspectors, including an offline-first inspection app.

• Servo POS: check-level discounts that stay right across split checks (using a split factor), multi-level modifier trees with safe stock tracking, menu and stock sync between devices over local sockets, receipt printing and card payments.
• One SwiftUI codebase running natively on iOS and Android.
• Flutter apps for iOS and Android, with Riverpod state management (also BLoC).
• Node.js + TypeScript REST API: JWT access and refresh tokens with proper server-side logout, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker and Swagger.
• I pick the solution that stays correct in real use, not the fastest one to build.
• I design for edge cases: no signal, split checks, shared modifiers, expired tokens.
• I lead and mentor: architecture, code reviews, CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
• I use AI tools daily, and I check everything they produce.
